attributes.title: MAPA Annual CME Conference 2027
attributes.summary:
The Minnesota Academy of Physician Associates moves its annual fall CME conference to Stillwater, on the St. Croix River east of the Twin Cities, for 2027. The save-the-date lists Thursday, September 23, and Friday, September 24.

MAPA says the education will be submitted for AAPA approval, but the 2027 venue, credit total, fees and hotel had not been announced when we checked. The fees and hotel link on the page refer to the 2026 meeting at Breezy Point, so don't budget from them. The conference is a chance for Minnesota PAs to earn Category 1 CME and meet colleagues from around the state.
